verdict.rationale: HMRC's own pages say its core registration transactions can be done online: registering for VAT via the 'register for VAT online service', most limited companies registering as employers online (with resumable applications), and signing up online for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. They also say you can manage Corporation Tax online through the business tax account. MTD filing runs through third-party compatible software, and a live production API platform responds, which supports the online filing rail. missing for 10: no evidence on the published pages that tax payments can be made online, Corporation Tax filing is described only as 'manage online', MTD submission depends on third-party software rather than an HMRC-native filing form, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of completing a transaction end to end.
